scope: Manually entered fixed-text functional smoke checks. Numbers and semantics require review; not classroom quality certification.

checks.title: [ACCEPTANCE] Manual translation fixture ZH
checks.source: A statistical association does not establish causation. The trial included 120 students, not 12. The error rate fell from 5 percent to 2 percent. A race condition occurs when concurrent operations depend on their timing. CRISPR-Cas9 can modify a targeted DNA sequence.
checks.translated: 统计关联并不能证明因果关系。实验包含 120 名学生，而非 12 名。错误率从 5% 降至 2%。当并发操作依赖于其执行顺序时，就会出现竞争条件。CRISPR-Cas9 可以修改特定的 DNA 序列。

checks.title: [ACCEPTANCE] Manual translation fixture JA
checks.source: A statistical association does not establish causation. The trial included 120 students, not 12. The error rate fell from 5 percent to 2 percent. A race condition occurs when concurrent operations depend on their timing. CRISPR-Cas9 can modify a targeted DNA sequence.
checks.translated: 統計的関連性は因果関係を証明するものではない。試験には120人の学生が参加したが、12人ではない。誤差率は5％から2％に低下した。並行操作がそのタイミングに依存する場合、競合状態が発生する。CRISPR-Cas9は特定されたDNA配列を変更することができる。

checks.title: [ACCEPTANCE] Manual translation fixture KO
checks.source: A statistical association does not establish causation. The trial included 120 students, not 12. The error rate fell from 5 percent to 2 percent. A race condition occurs when concurrent operations depend on their timing. CRISPR-Cas9 can modify a targeted DNA sequence.
checks.translated: 통계적 연관성은 인과관계를 입증하지 못한다. 시험에는 12명이 아닌 120명의 학생이 참여했다. 오류율은 5%에서 2%로 감소했다. 동시에 발생하는 작업이 각각의 타이밍에 의존하는 경우에는 레이스 조건이 발생한다. CRISPR-Cas9은 목표로 하는 DNA 서열을 변경할 수 있다.
